summary: Cross-PO allocation and tax withholding code mismatch blocking vendor payment
description:
Issue summary:
Vendor 'Stratus Logistics' invoice INV-2026-309 was entered against two internal cost centers and requires split allocation across PO-9982 and PO-10011. The ERP rejected the payment run due to a tax withholding code mismatch on the vendor master (vendor tax code: 'WHT-0', invoice line expects 'WHT-15').

Impact:
- Payment to Stratus is blocked in the March payroll/payment run.
- Two POs remain partially invoiced which prevents automatic close and affects month-end accruals.
- This is a high-priority AP hold affecting a critical vendor used by operations in EMEA.

Environment:
- Prod ERP (AcmePay v4.2) integrated with Redwood finance ledger.
- Payment run: PROD | us-east

Steps to reproduce / current state:
1. Invoice INV-2026-309 uploaded via supplier portal and matched to PO-9982 (line A) and PO-10011 (line B).
2. AP validation flagged tax withholding code mismatch and blocked posting to payments queue.
3. Attempted manual override via AP UI returned error: "Allocation tax code does not match vendor default - posting prevented."
4. Payments team attempted a manual wire but Finance policy requires vendor tax code alignment before payment for automated audit trail.

Supporting logs / references:
- ERP error trace (exported): TRACE-AP-20260310-7792 (attached in case file storage).
- Vendor communication thread: slack #finance-ops (https://slack.redwood/archives/C012345678)
- Related runbook: https://confluence.internal.redwood/finance/ap-vendor-tax-rules

Expected behavior:
- System should allow split PO allocation when invoice lines explicitly include line-level tax withholding codes, or AP should provide a validated manual exception flow where Finance approves a one-off payment.

Immediate ask / business ask:
- Short-term: Finance to approve manual payment (wire) for INV-2026-309 to avoid vendor service interruption if a safe audit trail can be produced.
- Medium-term: Coordinate with ERP-integration team to allow line-level withholding overrides when matched to multiple POs, or ensure vendor master tax code is updated before payment runs.

Notes:
- Vendor claims services will be suspended if not paid by 2026-03-15.
- PO-10011 is tied to an active customer project; delayed vendor payment could trigger deliverable risk.

investigation_notes: Vendor master tax code currently set to WHT-0. Invoice lines explicitly use WHT-15 on second line for service tax withheld at source.
ERP enforces vendor master tax code at posting time; mismatch rules prevent partial posting to preserve reporting integrity.
There exists a feature to allow line-level overrides behind a config flag (feature 'line_withholding_override'). Feature is disabled in prod by default.
Manual payment allowed by policy only with documented vendor confirmation; Finance requested proof of vendor tax treatment to create audit trail.
Risk: Enabling feature without tests could create inconsistent tax reporting across ledgers; need Finance sign-off and migration plan.
resolution: Pending: Manual wire staged and awaiting Finance sign-off. ERP team to deliver config toggle and tests for line-level withholding override (tracked PR #2431). Follow-up: update vendor master to consistent withholding code or normalize invoice line tax codes.
